remarks: Welcome to Woodside Green located in prime midtown Stamford location! This open and spacious one bedroom/one bath on the first floor, is drenched in natural sunlight and conveniently located just steps from Stamford's best hot spots! Inside, the unit features hardwood floors throughout, an open floor plan with kitchen featuring a large island & abundant cabinet space, dining room, and living room. The bedroom offers plenty of closet space as does the entry closet and the extra linen closet. All residents are afforded two parking spaces and guest passes. The HOA includes grounds maintenance, trash pickup, snow removal, hot water, water, sewer, property maintenance and insurance. Don't miss out on this opportunity to own your ideal space.
